components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The honorific title of the pet owner (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR). Optional. When present it is combined with the last name to form the salutation.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility
            when the structured 'addressLine1' is not supplied. On output it is the
            composed, normalized address: the normalized 'addressLine1' with a single
            space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when 'addressLine2' is
            present, or the normalized flat address when only the flat form was given.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred over
            the flat 'address' when supplied; normalized like the flat address on create.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (e.g. unit or suite). Normalized like the flat address on create and, when
            present, appended to 'addressLine1' in the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present. When supplied it must be valid for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional on input; defaults to the server's current date when omitted. Returned in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth. Optional. When supplied it is used to derive the ageBand relative to the registrationDate. Returned in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Deprecated and ignored. Household membership (same last name and postcode) is no longer rejected as a duplicate; duplicate detection is now based solely on the identityKey, and owners sharing a soundex(lastName) and postcode with a different identityKey are flagged as a soft match rather than rejected. Input only; not stored.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner, being '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, being the title and last name separated by a space (e.g. 'DR Who'), or just the last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for human display, being the calling code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: The owner's member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' where REGION is the region code derived from the postcode, FY is the two-digit fiscal year of the registrationDate, HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone followed by the last name, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of the '<REGION><FY><HASH8>' prefix.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by all owners in the same household, derived deterministically as the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name and the postcode ('normalizedLastName|postcode'). Owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically. Absent when no postcode was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of owners that already existed at the moment this owner was created sharing the same first name and last name (compared case-insensitively). Captured once at creation.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>', derived from the business-day-adjusted registrationDate. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named by the calendar year in which it ends (e.g. 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026 is 'FY26'). Absent when no registrationDate is known.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, starting at 0; add 2 when an email address is present; add 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0); add 2 for a household of 3 or more; add 3 for qualifying tenure (more than 1 elapsed fiscal year since registration).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true

## Summary

I implemented `riskFlag` as a derived (read-time) property on an owner, true when **any** of the three signals hold: possible duplicate, disposable-adjacent email domain, or city over its soft capacity.

Following the codebase's existing conventions (derived `@Transient` getters on `Owner` that delegate to static helpers in the `model` package, plus OpenAPI-generated DTOs mapped by MapStruct), I made four focused changes:

1. **New `model/DisposableEmailDomains.java`** — a single source of truth for disposable-provider knowledge. It owns the blocklist and exposes `domainOf`, `isDisposable` (exact match), and `isDisposableAdjacent` (subdomain of, or same registrable label under a different suffix as, a blocked domain — related without being one).

2. **`DisposableEmailDomainValidator`** — refactored to delegate to `DisposableEmailDomains` instead of holding its own copy of the blocklist, so the reject path and the risk-signal path read the same list (no duplication).

3. **`Owner.getRiskFlag()`** — a new `@Transient` getter combining `getPossibleDuplicate()`, the captured `capacityWarning` (the soft-capacity band of 40–49), and a private `hasDisposableAdjacentEmail()` helper. Each piece reuses existing state rather than recomputing it.

4. **`openapi.yml`** — added the `riskFlag` boolean property to the `Owner` schema so the generated `OwnerDto` gains the field and MapStruct auto-maps `owner.getRiskFlag()` onto it.

Design notes: the flag is computed purely from state already captured on the owner (possible-duplicate and capacity-warning are set once at creation; email is stored), so it stays consistent on every `GET`. The disposable-*adjacent* band is distinct from the disposable blocklist — blocklisted domains are rejected outright at creation, so a stored owner is never on the list itself but can be adjacent to it, which is exactly the softer risk signal the spec describes.
